subject: Next steps: third-party inventory & security action items
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Jordi Martinez <security@claritech.com>, Samira King <samira.king@claritech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: third-party inventory & security action items

Hi Jordi / Samira —

Great conversation today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get our security/compliance team comfortable for a pilot: 

Recap of what we discussed:
- SOC 2: you noted an ongoing program but no Type II report yet.
- Data residency & GDPR: you can isolate EU tenants, and default deployment is in US regions.
- HIPAA: you indicated you can be in-scope and sign a BAA for customers that require it.
- Subprocessors / third parties: you identified AWS and GCP for various functions; we need a more complete inventory.

Action items (requested from ClariTech):
1) Please upload a CSV export of your current subprocessor inventory (columns: vendor, service, purpose, data types processed, regions, contract signed Y/N).
2) Confirm SOC 2 status and expected Type II completion date, or provide a readiness/bridge letter if available.
3) Confirm GDPR/HIPAA scope and whether you will sign a BAA.
4) Clarify cloud/provider regions (e.g., AWS us-west-2 for production, GCP europe-west1 for analytics) and any cross-region replication.
5) Provide a short note on encryption (at-rest and in-transit) and KMS/BYOK usage.
6) If you can, complete our vendor security questionnaire: https://forms.redwood.ai/vsq/CLT-0421 (attached link stub).

Timeline: if you can share the CSV + initial answers by EOD Friday 2027-02-20, that should keep us on track for a pilot review the following week. If you need a technical deep-dive we can block 30 min — suggested window Thu 2027-02-24 morning PT.

Attachments: vendor security questionnaire link (stub).

Thanks — small set of asks, and we can iterate after we review.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire_ClariTech-link.txt (contains link to VSQ)

From: Jordi Martinez <security@claritech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira King <samira.king@claritech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2027 16:30:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: third-party inventory & security action items

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the clean recap. Attaching the two items I can share today and answering the quick bullets inline below.

Attachments: claritech_subprocessor_inventory.csv, claritech_initial_vendor_answers.pdf

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: We are currently in the final phase of our SOC 2 Type II audit; expected issuance target is mid-April 2027. We do have a SOC 2 Type I from 2026 and can provide a bridge letter (we will upload by Mar 15).
- GDPR: We operate globally; EU tenant isolation is supported. We process customer personal data as a data processor per contract.
- HIPAA: We handle PHI for a small set of customers; we are willing to execute a BAA. Please flag if ClariTech will need BAA terms up front.
- Cloud providers & regions: Production on AWS (us-west-2), analytics workloads on GCP (us-central1 / europe-west1), backups occasionally in Azure (eastus) for DR. Cross-region replication exists for backups only.
- Encryption & keys: Data encrypted at rest using provider-managed KMS by default. We can support BYOK for enterprise customers — please confirm if Redwood requires BYOK.

We'll complete the online questionnaire link you provided and share any additional artifacts. Expect the full CSV and questionnaire submission by EOD Friday 2027-02-20. If anything in the attached CSV looks off, flag it and we'll correct.

Thanks,
Jordi Martinez
Head of Security Operations
ClariTech
security@claritech.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordi Martinez <security@claritech.com>, Samira King <samira.king@claritech.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: third-party inventory & security action items

Thanks Jordi — that helps. A couple of technical clarifications from the infra side so we can scope any additional reqs:

On Wed, Feb 18, 2027 at 4:30 PM Jordi Martinez <security@claritech.com> wrote:
> 
> - Cloud providers & regions: Production on AWS (us-west-2), analytics workloads on GCP (us-central1 / europe-west1), backups occasionally in Azure (eastus) for DR. Cross-region replication exists for backups only.
> - Encryption & keys: Data encrypted at rest using provider-managed KMS by default. We can support BYOK for enterprise customers — please confirm if Redwood requires BYOK.

Questions we need answered for our security checklist:
1) For BYOK: do you support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS/Cloud KMS/HSM? If yes, which providers and what is the provisioning flow?
2) Audit logs: retention period and ability to stream logs (CloudTrail / Stackdriver) to customer-owned S3/GCS for forensic analysis?
3) Data sent to GCP for analytics — is it pseudonymized or raw customer-identifiable data? Is there any downstream transfer to third parties?
4) Access controls: do you use role-based access with MFA enforced for admin & SRE accounts? Any outside contractor access?
5) Do you have a sample DPIA or privacy impact assessment for EU data processing?
6) CSV schema: can you confirm the exact column names you used in claritech_subprocessor_inventory.csv (we prefer vendor, service, purpose, data_types, regions, contract_signed, last_review_date).

If you can provide these details by Friday we can proceed without additional paperwork. Otherwise let's take the 30-min technical call — Thu 2027-02-24 at 09:30 PT works for me.

- Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Samira King <samira.king@claritech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordi Martinez <security@claritech.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2027 18:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: third-party inventory & security action items

Thanks everyone — we will action the items below. Short answers and next steps: 

- BYOK: we support customer-managed keys for AWS KMS and Google Cloud KMS; provisioning is currently manual (customer provides key material and we configure). We'll include a short KB on the exact flow.
- Audit logs: we retain CloudTrail/Stackdriver for 90 days by default; streaming to customer-owned buckets is supported with an additional configuration step.
- Analytics data: analytics pipelines receive pseudonymized identifiers by default; raw PII never flows into GCP analytics without explicit customer opt-in.
- Access controls: RBAC with MFA for privileged roles; contractor access is via time-limited user accounts and reviewed quarterly.
- DPIA: attaching a sample privacy impact summary and a link to our DPIA template.

We'll upload the requested CSV schema and a completed vendor security questionnaire to the link you provided by EOD Friday 2027-02-20. We can confirm the technical call Thu 2027-02-24 at 09:30 PT — Samira and Jordi will join.

Regards,
Samira King
VP, Product & Ops
ClariTech
samira.king@claritech.com
